name: 9router-copilot-chat-provider
description: Expose 9router as a custom provider inside GitHub Copilot Chat.

9router-copilot.baseUrl.description: Base URL for the 9router OpenAI-compatible API.

9router-copilot.displayModels.description: Curated product models shown in the Copilot Chat model picker.

9router-copilot.labels.daily.description: Display label for the Daily model.

9router-copilot.labels.agent.description: Display label for the Agent model.

9router-copilot.labels.fallback.description: Display label for the Fallback model.

9router-copilot.modelMappings.daily.description: Existing 9router combo id used by the Daily display model. The model stays hidden until configured.

9router-copilot.modelMappings.agent.description: Existing 9router combo id used by the Agent display model. The model stays hidden until configured.

9router-copilot.modelMappings.fallback.description: Existing 9router combo id used by the Fallback display model. The model stays hidden until configured.

9router-copilot.toolMode.daily.description: Tool exposure mode for the Daily display model.

9router-copilot.toolMode.agent.description: Tool exposure mode for the Agent display model.

9router-copilot.toolMode.fallback.description: Tool exposure mode for the Fallback display model.

9router-copilot.visionMode.daily.description: Vision mode for Daily. Use native when the mapped 9router combo can accept image inputs directly, proxy for text-only combos, and off to block image inputs.

9router-copilot.visionMode.agent.description: Vision mode for Agent. Use native when the mapped 9router combo can accept image inputs directly, proxy for text-only combos, and off to block image inputs.

9router-copilot.visionMode.fallback.description: Vision mode for Fallback. Use native when the mapped 9router combo can accept image inputs directly, proxy for text-only combos, and off to block image inputs.

9router-copilot.thinkingMode.daily.description: Thinking level for Daily. Non-off values are forwarded through the 9router model suffix contract.

9router-copilot.thinkingMode.agent.description: Thinking level for Agent. Non-off values are forwarded through the 9router model suffix contract.

9router-copilot.thinkingMode.fallback.description: Thinking level for Fallback. Non-off values are forwarded through the 9router model suffix contract.

scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:integration
